channel.title: India News Today with Nisha
channel.description: A daily two-to-three minute bulletin of India's top news: politics, business and markets, entertainment and cricket. Nisha is an AI-voiced newsreader; stories are researched and checked by an AI assistant.

item.title: India News Today – Tuesday, October 13, 2026
item.description: We start in Delhi, where the opposition staged one of its biggest shows of strength in years. Sixteen INDIA bloc parties led thousands of people through central Delhi on Monday to protest against Chief Election Commissioner Gyanesh Kumar.
